blueprint.summary: No-code trigger-and-action automation. Quick for simple flows; branching or high-volume flows get awkward and costly, where a script is simpler.
use_when: A simple trigger and one or two actions

setup.do: Estimate monthly tasks: each successful action step is one task.

steps.do: Build the trigger and actions, keeping filters and formatters free of task cost.
Move the flow to a script once it needs many branches or high volume.

pitfalls.issue: Branching and volume make flows awkward and costly
pitfalls.fix: Use code or a script for those cases

pitfalls.issue: Code steps time out fast on lower plans
pitfalls.fix: Check the plan's code runtime before putting logic in a code step

free_alternatives: A scheduled script for high-volume flows

limits.note: At the limit, runs are held until reset unless pay-per-task billing is on
JavaScript or Python only, with runtime and rate limits by plan

docs.title: How is task usage measured in Zapier?

verify_live: Code step runtime for the current plan
